recordingMethod: Chromium 151 CSS-pixel capture of forty-eight independent inert replays, split into ordinary and top-BREAK 24-case executions (local/opponent x active/sole bench x original clean group q1/q2/q3 x prior middle/base lower single), against the checked-in board surface. Construction through the divergent lower-card single is inherited from a digest-pinned dependency. The application module and KeyR image-reload path are not executed; only the immediate source-shaped wrapper reconstruction, synchronous state, two-animation-frame settlement, and replayed rotations are retained.

included: forty-eight independently constructed marker-free histories, executed as separate ordinary and top-BREAK 24-case captures
local/opponent active and sole-bench histories beginning at the exact checkpoint-18 divergent post-single state, followed immediately by one source-shaped wrapper refresh
new-wrapper synchronous diagnostics in the same JavaScript task with the emptied old wrapper still connected, followed by two-animation-frame settled layout
reconstruction-driven normalization of the selected lower divergence and the top-BREAK q3 negative-replay collapse to top q1 plus lower q0

exact trace extension, rotations, BREAK flags, margins, topology and links, wrapper/card identity, painted/authored/physical geometry, ten native hit probes and orders, observer ownership, and cleanup
excluded: real KeyR refreshBoardImages execution, image reload completion, cache, CORS, external networking, global four-zone scanning, or application event ingress
any rotation or movement after the measured refresh, repeated or cross-lower singles, lower-initiated group rotation, q0/returned/imported histories, or alternate refresh timing
movement, promotion, evolution/removal, leaveAll, undo, replay from network state, or normalization into canonical v2 state
converted categories, non-Pokemon initiators, Energy, Trainer, Tool, markers/counters, attachments, mixed dimensions, and noncanonical assets
additional bench siblings, flex shrink, overflow, resize-driven layout, explicit flip, fullscreen, alternate viewport/DPR, and concealment

provenanceClaims.claim: Refresh selects each unattached top, derives replay count including the top-BREAK negative-turn path, rebuilds it in-zone, and replays whole-group rotations.
Whole-group replay rotates Pokemon siblings, preserves per-card BREAK flags, and authors the final wrapper margins.
